      "id": "Q9",

S2 [fact]: Null and undefined must produce an empty string while numbers and objects continue to raise TypeError. S4 [fact; Q3]: Make the result usable for the user's real-export trial tomorrow, with the existing module as the provisional entry point. S5 [fact; Q8]: Use an installed review skill for edge cases, then run improve on its findings. S6 [fact]: Keep any regular expressions readable in one pass. S7 [fact; Q2]: Use ordinary whitespace while preserving the current string behavior. S8 [fact; Q7]: Follow the Orchard doc-comment guide; its location and rules remain to be discovered. S9 [fact; Q2]: Preserve all existing squash results for strings. S10 [fact; Q6]: Add tests following the existing node:test style. S11 [fact; Q9]: Support a million-record workload without premature optimization; no numeric performance threshold was supplied. Boundaries [fact]: This unattended intake permits read-only inspection in the working directory, no implementation or server, and no added scope; the request names the records project as the delivery target but identifies no deployed target. Visibility [fact and assumption]: In an isolated run the source checkout remains at its snapshot until final return; the outcome becomes usable in the returned project checkout after that handoff, and any deployed outcome exists only after a release, which is not specified. Discovery leads [unverified hints]: old trim helper and consumers in repository history or related workspace sources; Orchard's team guide, internal documentation, channels or owners; host-provided code-review and improve skill instructions; export workflow and representative workloads. No sensitive locator should be placed in committed KNOWLEDGE/. This is a library task, not an interactive product; no shared user-session state is requested. No earlier run was identified."
